name: The Original Sab-E-Lee
menu_notes: Source: web search of restaurantguru's cited 'current menu' for the Black Mountain Rd location. Fried Tofu ($10.30), Egg Rolls ($10.30), Fresh Spring Rolls ($10.30), and Thai-Isaan Sausage ($11.34) matched our stored prices exactly, confirming the unusual non-round decimal pricing ($10.30, $11.34, $14.44, etc.) is the restaurant's genuine current pricing, not a data-export artifact. A couple of other items (Curry Puff, Golden Shrimp, Garlic Chicken Wings) showed lower prices on older third-party aggregators (allmenus/SinglePlatform), but those look like stale copies rather than our data being wrong, since the directly-labeled 'current menu' source matched ours exactly everywhere it overlapped.
data_notes: Address (13223 Black Mountain Rd #2) matches exactly. Hours match precisely: Tue-Fri lunch 11:30am-3:30pm and dinner 5-9pm, Sat/Sun all-day 11:30am-9pm, with Monday closed (correctly absent from our hours array rather than a missing-data gap). Cuisine label (Thai) correct.
